editorial:
Imagine starting out as a street kid with nothing and ending up as a mastermind planning one of the biggest heists in history. You get to follow a young hoodlum who grows up fast and learns the ropes of the crime world, eventually aiming for a massive $2.5 million payday. The movie feels like a gritty trip through the old school crime scene, showing you exactly how these guys thought and how they planned every single step of the robbery. It is less about flashy explosions and more about the tension of trying to pull off the perfect crime without getting caught.

What really works here is how the movie shows the mental strain on the robbers as they get closer to the big day. The acting is solid and the pacing keeps you wondering if they can actually pull it off. While it is an older film, the detail put into the robbery mechanics is still impressive. If you enjoy true crime stories, you should definitely track this down. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see the best picture quality, or just look for it to rent on Apple TV for a quick movie night.
endingExplained: After the big heist is successful, the group thinks they have won it all. However, the law slowly catches up with them as the thieves start to turn on each other. Greed and paranoia break the gang apart, leading to their eventual arrests. You see that no matter how perfect the plan was, they could not escape the consequences of their actions. The movie ends with the realization that the money was not worth the price they paid.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime and old school heist movies.
